assessment: This study offers a valuable finding using a mouse model exposed to PM2.5 samples collected from highly polluted city air. The solid evidence provided strongly supports the assertions of the authors that PM2.5 triggers a KLF9/CYP1A1 signaling pathway, resulting in placental dysfunction, oxidative stress, mitochondrial issues, and adverse gestational outcomes. This research holds substantial relevance for medical biologists engaged in studying environmental factors impacting maternal and fetal health.
